body.x: Polaris3D will be participating in CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from Jan. 8 (Tue) to Jan. 11 (Fri), 2019. MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT BOOTH # 52843) to showcase its indoor robot autonomous navigation solution. Polaris3D sells solutions that help indoor robots to run autonomously. Because there are many GPS shaded areas in the room, it is difficult to apply outdoor autonomous driving technology. To solve these problems, Polaris3D has developed a solution that enables robot autonomous navigation by simply mounting it. The solution has the advantage that it implements safe and precise autonomous driving through robust algorithms and does not require the installation of additional facilities in the space to be applied.

Thisindoor robot autonomous navigation solution adopts a new algorithm in SLAMtechnology and is suitable for indoor self-driving. Not only that, Polaris3Dsucceeded in developing a more robust positioning technology by separatingmapping and localization. The Polaris3D solution, which has low computationalcost, is light enough to be applied to drones, and has the advantage of easycontrol by providing easy control software.

Polaris3D,who participates in this CES with Kyungpook National University Smart VentureCampus, will look for a company that needs a logistics warehouse autonomousmobile robot and an indoor environment safety inspection robot. The company wouldalso like to have a meeting with a robot manufacturer who would like to includean autonomous navigation function.

Polaris3Dplans to launch a new autonomous mobile robot in cooperation with various robotmanufacturers in the future. Although the company has successfully developed ahigh-precision solution using 3D LiDAR, we will develop and sell expansionsolutions (ANS +, ANS ++) using sensors optimized for the environment. Inaddition, we will identify the customer's needs for autonomous driving and presentalgorithms for leading autonomous driving.

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which is a global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea's start-up into the global market, is attracting attention with various activities such as exhibition, pitching and party. Also, on the third evening of the exhibition, MIK NIGHT party, a business networking party, will be held. In addition, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and GMEG, a global MICE specialist company. CES 2019 is an innovative exhibition where technology companies that will lead the fourth industrial revolution will participate. The main categories are 3D Printing, Accessibility, Advertising, Marketing, Content and Entertainment, AR / VR and Gaming, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Audio and Video , Baby Tech, CES Sports Zone, Country Pavilions, Design & Source Showcase, Digital Money, Drones, Enterprise Solutions, Eureka Park, Family and Kids Tech, Fitness, Health and Wellness, Home Cinema, IoT Infrastructure, iProducts , Resilience, Self-Driving Technology, Sleep Tech, Smart Cities, Smart Home, Sports Tech, Tourism, Vehicle Technology, Wearables, Wireless Devices and Services.
